Fresh seeds 13–22 gave 0.7525 for this recipe, so the population mean is ~0.752–0.753, only 0.2–0.3 pp over the 0.75 bar. The tip sits at the accuracy cliff.

Mechanisms:
1. Early low resolution is cheap (E026, E033). E040 (40/0/30/30) saved ~0.12 s and cost ~0.06 pp on seeds 0–2. The 32 px tail and the 3×3 final-map regime carry accuracy (E011, E018, E024).

3. Averaging, LS, warmup and Lookahead-interval tweaks (E025, E029, E030, E032) are null or negative by 0.2–0.7 pp. The recipe is in a narrow local optimum, so shade any non-systems change by about −0.1 pp.
4. wd ×0.5 helped ~0.2 pp (E016). Muon's gain is confounded with batch size and an RNG re-draw (E006).
5. Systems work is worth ~1% each. Math-identical changes keep per-seed outcomes bit-identical (E035). The remaining ones are ≲0.1 s each.
6. Sample dropping (E031) costs ~0.4 pp for ~0.5 s, worse than the epoch dial.

Misses: the E034 and E037 times (memory-bound savings are larger than I modelled), and the accuracy cost of the deeper freeze.

forecasts.reason: Diagnostic with no recipe change. Profiling will likely show non-GEMM kernels at ≥30% of step time and group 1 plus whitening at ≥35%.
Cutting 12 steps at 20 px saves ~0.09 s and costs ~0.1 pp. It sits near the bar and does not clear 0.753 reliably.
Freezing conv1 at 60% is a partial dose of E037, which cost 0.4 pp. Expect a smaller loss and a smaller time saving.
Moving the freeze from 75% to 70% saves ~0.05 s. The accuracy cost is probably ~0.1 pp, since E037's cliff points to the dose being nonlinear.
Recomputing BN stats may give a small gain, but the BN momentum of 0.6 already tracks recent stats. The cost is ~0.03 s.
16 px saves a little, since small maps are inefficient. The accuracy cost is probably ~0.1 pp.
Math-identical, so per-seed accuracies stay bit-identical. It saves ~0.02–0.03 s on the mean.

cruxes: What is the true population mean of the tip: is it 0.7525 or 0.7535? That decides whether any trim is viable.
Is there any time-neutral accuracy booster (LS 0.1, Muon lr ×2, batch 1500) that adds ≥0.2 pp?
Does the nonlinear freeze cliff come from the 28→32 px switch or from the group-1 dose?
